data.one_liner: An image cropper widget written in pure Dart with 90-degree rotation support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable crop image widget that works across mobile, web, and desktop without relying on native mobile cropper packages. Allows programmatic control over crop rectangles, aspect ratios, and rotations.
use_when: You need a cross-platform image cropper widget built entirely in Dart
You need to customize the appearance of the crop grid, corners, and scrim
You want to programmatically control aspect ratios, sizes, and rotations
avoid_when: You are using Flutter Web with the HTML web renderer and need to call croppedBitmap() (CanvasKit is required)
You want a fully featured native photo editing UI kit with filters and drawings
strengths: Written completely in Dart without external native mobile dependencies
Supports all platforms supported by Flutter: mobile, web, and desktop
Offers a CropController for programmatic manipulation of crop and rotation
weaknesses: croppedBitmap() and croppedImage() result in an exception on Flutter Web using the HTML web renderer
